items.title: A map of spectral spaces is spectral exactly when it is continuous for the constructible topology
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a continuous map of spectral spaces is spectral exactly when it is continuous for the constructible topology (author lemma at source lines 4620-4625, label lemma-spectral-if-continuous-wrt-constructible-top). The proof (source lines 4627-4642) takes the easy direction from the earlier statement on spectral maps and, in the converse, shows that preimages of quasi-compact opens are clopen and quasi-compact in the constructible topology, then transfers quasi-compactness back along the identity (proof lines 4627-4641). The transfer of quasi-compactness is the substance. H3.
